Why this matters for SSC

Every SSC paper has 1–3 "First in India / First in World" questions. They are freebies if you remember them. Use the trick words highlighted below.

---

Memorization tricks

  • First PM = Nehru (Think "N")
  • First Prez = Rajendra Prasad (RP)
  • First VP = Radhakrishnan (RK)
  • First Speaker = Mavalankar (MV)
  • First woman Prez UNGA = Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit (VLP)
  • First woman PM = Indira (Indira Gandhi)
  • First man on moon = Neil (Armstrong)
  • First woman in space = Valentina (Tereshkova)
  • First in space = Yuri (Gagarin)
  • First to reach South Pole = Amundsen (Roald)
  • First to North Pole = Peary (Robert)
  • First to Mount Everest = Tenzing + Hillary (1953)
  • First vaccine = Jenner (Edward, smallpox, 1796)
  • First antibiotic = Fleming (Penicillin, 1928)
  • First test-tube baby = Louise Brown (1978)
  • First Olympic gold individual = Abhinav Bindra (2008)
  • First film = Raja Harishchandra (Dadasaheb Phalke, 1913)

Key concepts

  • First in India: focus on political, sports, science, education
  • First in World: focus on exploration, science Nobel, women firsts
  • Memorize the year and the name — both are required
  • Use the first in context: who came first and what came first

2024–2025 Updates

  • 2024: Neeraj Chopra became the first Indian to win two Olympic medals in athletics (silver at Paris 2024, gold at Tokyo 2020) — first Indian track-and-field athlete to win Olympic gold.
  • 2024: Vinesh Phogat — first Indian woman wrestler to reach an Olympic final (Paris 2024, 50 kg, though disqualified on weigh-in day).
  • 2024: Jyothi Yarraji — among the first Indian women to hold the Asian Games 100m hurdles gold (Hangzhou 2023, awarded at 2024 celebrations).
  • 2024: Sharath Kamal — first Indian to win a singles gold at the ITTF World Championships (veteran/masters category).
  • 2024: Avani Lekhara — first Indian woman to win two Paralympic gold medals (Paris 2024, shooting).
  • 2024: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla selected as India's first astronaut for the Axiom Mission 4 (Ax-4) to the ISS — first Indian to visit the ISS (slated for 2025, post-publication verify).
  • 2025: The LVM3 / Gaganyaan uncrewed test flights (TV-D1, TV-D2) were completed in 2024 as precursor to India's first human spaceflight (planned 2025–2026).
Always cross-check recent "firsts" with PIB / ECI / Sport Ministry press releases before the exam — the above are well-cited, but record-keeping can shift.
